_doc: R42: The Gauntlet — the post-dominion tier. Four boss-scale units (stratofortress, leviathan_dredge, crucible_9000, the_compliance_engine) were drafted at R25 with full stat blocks, moves, shapes, salvage and KO lines, and A5 measured that they fit no strip without a rescale — so they sat parked behind a pinned gate for seventeen phases. A veteran stable is the thing they fit: R41's trajectory math says a creature that fights the whole campaign arrives at dominion at L8, and a realistic diet caps it at L10 near the finale. Stages unlock in order, the first when the county is yours (dominionAt, R40); each is one derived encounter — authored escorts, then the boss — with no node, no income and no notoriety: prestige fights, with the purse and whatever the Containment Cannon can bag (capturing THE COMPLIANCE ENGINE is the intended jackpot — its salvage carries the game's only apex mandate_horn). scaleOverride is tuned with the harness against prime-grade L8-L10 stables, benched per stage; the director does not rewrite a Gauntlet fight, because these ARE the coalition's answer. Adding a fifth stage must never require engine edits.

stages.name: Exhibition I — The Stratofortress
stages.blurb: The coalition has been keeping something in a hangar upstate. The hangar is now empty and the sky is full.
stages.news: EXHIBITION MATCH: local geneticist versus the airborne mortgage of an entire county. Tickets free, attendance mandatory.

stages.name: Exhibition II — The Leviathan Dredge
stages.blurb: It has been dredging the same harbour for forty years. Today it is dredging in your direction.
stages.news: EXHIBITION MATCH: the harbour's largest resident takes a personal day. Swimmers advised to be elsewhere, permanently.

stages.name: Exhibition III — CRUCIBLE-9000
stages.blurb: The Foundry's founding furnace, on treads. It does not make steel anymore. It makes examples.
stages.news: EXHIBITION MATCH: CRUCIBLE-9000 leaves the Foundry for the first time since its warranty expired. Roads pre-melted for its convenience.

stages.name: Exhibition IV — THE COMPLIANCE ENGINE
stages.blurb: Head office's final asset. It has your file. It has everyone's file. It is, in the fullest sense, the paperwork.
stages.news: FINAL EXHIBITION: THE COMPLIANCE ENGINE has been signed out of storage. The signature took four days.
